Name: Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic
Author: Poltergeister
TagLine: Overhauls all character sprites and portraits for a slightly cuter aesthetic
Description:
Hello and welcome, everyone!

This mod combines my [Slightly Cuter Character Sprites](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437) and [Slightly Edited Portraits](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4824) mods, and gives characters seasonal outfits. Mods with the same aesthetic are also available for [East Scarp](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045) and [Stardew Valley Expanded](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969).

This mod was heavily inspired by the dynamic NPC clothing system from [Longevity](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/649) and [Seasonal Villager Outfits](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2449?tab=description). All villagers have one outfit per season (plus a winter outdoor variation), as well as Flower Dance and Spirit's Eve costumes. Spouses also have outfits for all additional festivals.

The farmer can also be configured to change into seasonal outfits and wear long or short-sleeved clothing, as well as boots or half-shoes.

**Settings**

I highly recommend using Generic Mod Config Menu to change this mod's settings. It provides a UI that makes applying changes easier and helps prevent errors. Since version 6.1.0, every setting includes a description explaining its function, available options, and default value.

Here are some settings that require special consideration:
**WinterClothing**
Affects which winter assets are used. Choose IndoorAndOutdoor if you want NPCs to bundle up when going outside. Consider setting this to IndoorOnly or OutdoorOnly if you notice issues during winter in multiplayer.

**SlightlyCuterNPC**
Enables slightly cuter assets for a given NPC. Example: set SlightlyCuterAbigail to false if you do not wish to use her cuter version. Neither the portrait nor sprite will be loaded. If you use other mods that edit NPC portraits or sprites, make sure to disable the affected NPCs.

**SlightlyCuterFarmer**
Edits the farmer sprites to match the Slightly Cuter Aesthetic. The options below _REQUIRE_ this setting to be enabled. Disable this option if you use other mods that edit the farmer's base assets, such as [Get Glam](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044).

**HideFarmerNose**
A separate toggle that hides the farmer's nose when enabled.

**FemaleShoeStyle**
Affects the shoe style used by female farmer sprites. Male farmer sprites always use the Flat option. Check the mod images to see an example.

**SeasonalFarmerAppearance**
Allows the farmer's outfit to change with the seasons. Customize the clothing used for each season using the Shirt and Shoe settings.

**LocalClimateOverride**
Overrides the farmer's outfit to match the current location's climate. For example, Ginger Island will use summer clothing even if it is winter on the mainland.

**Compatibility**

This mod is mostly compatible with other mods. Here is what you need to know:

*   When using another mod that edits portraits and/or sprites, you will need to disable the affected NPCs in the settings. For example, if you install a mod that changes Sebastian's portraits, you should disable the SlightlyCuterSebastian setting.
Portraits and sprites cannot currently be selected independently, so unless another mod edits both portraits and sprites, one of them will still use the vanilla assets.

*   If you use mods that customize the farmer sprites, you will need to disable the SlightlyCuterFarmer setting.

*   This mod is also compatible with [Stardew Valley Expanded](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753). However, SVE adds new sprites and portraits for Marlon, Morris, and Gunther. This means the cuter versions of those characters will be incomplete.
Download [Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969) if you want a consistent visual style.

**Thanks and Credits**

Many thanks to Ailin, Alvadea, Airyn, Hopewashere, Tanpoponoko and all the other artists whose art I used as a basis for this mod. A full list of credits can be found in the credit section of this page.
Thanks also to paradigmnomad who let me use their code from SVO to create the original code of this mod. Thanks to Ayrin for creating the 4.0.0 code. Thanks to Agent Lyoko for creating the 6.0.0 code which uses the new appearance system introduced in 1.6 for faster load times!
Ty to jayjaydub for maintaining my mods!

I hope you enjoy this mod!
